Comfort & lifestyle

Thoughtfully Curated Amenities.

Every essential amenity is purposefully integrated to elevate your daily routine without exorbitant maintenance burdens.

  • Dedicated fitness space equipped for everyday health and personal wellness routines.

    Thoughtfully conceived fitness zone with high-grade workout equipment, natural ventilation, and an inspiring environment right within your residential tower.

  • An exclusive resident recreation lounge for leisure, table sports and friendly community engagements.

    Designed as a tranquil recreation setting where residents and their guests can unwind over billiards, table games, and indoor leisure activities.

  • 1 automated high-speed elevator with 8-passenger capacity serving all levels.

    Equipped with modern safety sensors, ARD (Automatic Rescue Device), smooth variable-frequency drive, and refined brushed metal finishes connecting basement parking to all residential floors.

  • Dedicated basement and ground level covered parking bays designed for smooth vehicle circulation.

    Spacious individual parking spaces with wide driveways, secure access ramps, clear markings, and effortless direct connectivity to the residential elevator lobby.

  • Safe, uninterrupted piped cooking gas directly routed to individual residential kitchens.

    Modern centralised gas bank with individual safety shut-off valves, precision metering, and concealed pipeline distribution eliminating the hassle of cylinder handling.

  • Round-the-clock digital surveillance across common entrances, corridors, parking, and perimeter.

    High-definition security cameras strategically positioned at building entry gates, lift lobbies, basement parking, and common perimeters for complete resident peace of mind.

Neighbourhood & connectivity

Connected to Everything. Close to What Matters.
